brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: Portable electronics organizer built from a hex base
requirements.evidence: Three base pieces: full hex base at (0,0), half-w at (1,0), half-n at (0,-1), joined by a joint bolt at (0,0)/(1,0).

requirements.requirement: Base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: Full-depth 2-compartment bin (hex-bin-full-div2) dropped into cell (0,0). It hangs on its rim and can be lifted out.
Drawer drawer:0#0,-1#cut (style s) on the cut face of the half-n base at (0,-1).
Handle handle:0,0,0;top with its three inserts, sitting on the triangle of covers at (0,0), (1,0) and (0,-1), which was required for the handle to fit.
Compact three-cell footprint with a carry handle, but this checks fit only; no weight or strength rating was verified and the joint between the half-n base and the others was not separately bolted.

finish.summary: Built a compact portable organizer: a 2-compartment removable bin, one drawer, and a carry handle over three covered cells. check_build reports no errors, meshClash "clear". Only info-level open cap face notices remain. Portability is shown by footprint and handle only, not by any load or weight check.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Grab handle
parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
